name: ViaProxy
author: support@pterodactyl.io
description: SLNE ViaProxy build. Install/reinstall fetches the latest published build from SLNE-Development/ViaProxy. No runtime auto-update.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl jq ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

TMP_JAR="/mnt/server/ViaProxy.jar.tmp"
FINAL_JAR="/mnt/server/ViaProxy.jar"
rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"
trap 'rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"' EXIT

if ! RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 https://api.github.com/repos/SLNE-Development/ViaProxy/releases/latest)"; then
  echo "Could not resolve the latest SLNE ViaProxy GitHub release." >&2
  exit 64
fi

DOWNLOAD_URL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name == "ViaProxy.jar") | .browser_download_url][0] // empty')"
if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
  echo "Latest SLNE ViaProxy release does not contain ViaProxy.jar." >&2
  exit 65
fi

if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o "${TMP_JAR}"; then
  echo "Failed to download ViaProxy.jar from the latest SLNE release." >&2
  exit 66
fi
if [ ! -s "${TMP_JAR}" ]; then
  echo "Downloaded ViaProxy JAR is missing or empty." >&2
  exit 67
fi

mv -f "${TMP_JAR}" "${FINAL_JAR}"
trap - EXIT
echo "Installed latest SLNE ViaProxy release as ${FINAL_JAR}."
